verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents API/SDK parity for many core actions — tracing (SDKs, OTEL), prompt management, scores/evaluations via API/SDK, dataset experiments via SDK, and a Metrics API v2 for aggregate queries — plus a CLI and MCP server for coding-agent access. However, several UI-centric features (alerting configuration, dashboards, annotation queues, RBAC/enterprise settings) are described only as UI actions with no explicit API equivalent, and one community comment notes the trace-retrieval API was too slow for bulk use, requiring direct DB queries as a workaround. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for alerts/dashboard creation, annotation-queue management, and independent confirmation that all UI actions have API parity without performance caveats.
